name: lazyfox-site
description: The Lazyfox product page: Vite + React, prerendered to static HTML and published to GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
